title: North Lakeway Village Window Cleaning, Pure Water | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for North Lakeway Village homes in Sections 1 to 6 around Lake Como Drive. Webs and sprinkler spots cleared, $10 per window outside.
h1: Window cleaning in North Lakeway Village
intro: North Lakeway Village is a six section neighborhood of 2000s homes, including those along Lake Como Drive. CleanzATX knows the area and cleans windows here throughout the year.

sections.h2: What North Lakeway Village homes are like
paragraphs: The neighborhood is platted in Sections 1 through 6 and holds several hundred homes, many built in the 2000s. Sizes run from about 2,100 to 4,300 square feet, and prices go from the high $500Ks to $1.05M. North Lakeway Village HOA manages the community, and there is no gate. Lake Como Drive is one of the main streets.
Homes from the 2000s have had time for landscaping to fill in. Front yards have established beds, and backyards are often shaded by trees planted when the houses were new.

sections.h2: What North Lakeway Village windows deal with
paragraphs: Mature landscaping brings its own set of problems. Tree branches drop pollen, seeds and leaf bits. Spiders live in shrubs close to the glass. Beds near windows are watered often, and those sprinklers leave white mineral spots on the lower row of panes.

Twenty years of weather can also bring rubber seals and tracks to a worn state. Dirt in tracks can keep windows from closing fully. Cleaning tracks costs $5, and screens are $5 each. Cedar pollen peaks in winter and live oak in spring, so many owners clean both before and after those seasons.

sections.h2: How we work North Lakeway Village
paragraphs: The layout is easy for us. Streets are open, there is no gate and driveways give room to park. Water fed poles reach upper glass from the ground and avoid scuffing landscaping. Interiors are done by hand with drop cloths. Because sections are arranged close together, nearby owners can request visits on the same day and we line them up efficiently. Gutters and house soft wash pair well with windows on 2000s homes with shaded roofs.

For a 3,000 square foot home, the exterior comes to about $300, and about two to three hours of work. Adding interior windows at $15 per window for inside and out takes about 90 minutes more. Twice a Year takes 10% off.

faq.q: Do you clean on Lake Como Drive?
faq.a: Yes. Lake Como Drive and the surrounding streets are part of our regular Lakeway routes. Text your address and we confirm a time.

faq.q: My tracks are full of dirt. Can you clean them?
faq.a: Yes, tracks are $5. We brush and wipe them so windows slide more freely. It is worth doing at least once a year.
Yes. Gutters are $1.50 per linear foot on one story, $2.25 on two and $3.25 on three. Tree cover in this area fills them with seeds and leaves.

faq.q: How often should I book windows?
faq.a: Many owners choose Twice a Year or Triannual. With Triannual you get 15% off, a yearly free screen cleaning and hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit.
